title: FedCSGA: Evolutionary Client Selection with Joint Statistical and System Heterogeneity in Federated Learning
abstract: arXiv:2611.04667v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Federated Learning (FL) enables collaborative training of machine learning models across distributed clients while preserving data privacy. In practical deployments, FL relies on selecting a client subset in each communication round to reduce communication cost, mitigate stragglers, and improve training efficiency under heterogeneous data and system conditions. In heterogeneous edge computing environments, both statistical heterogeneity and system heterogeneity significantly affect convergence efficiency and model performance. However, existing client selection methods often address these factors independently, overlooking their coupled and dynamic impact across communication rounds. To address this limitation, we propose FedCSGA, a Client Selection method for Federated learning based on Genetic Algorithm. translated_title: FedCSGA：联邦学习中联合统计与系统异构性的进化客户端选择方法
translated_abstract: 联邦学习（Federated Learning, FL）能够在保护数据隐私的前提下，跨分布式客户端协同训练机器学习模型。在实际部署中，联邦学习需要在每轮通信中选择一个客户端子集，以降低通信开销、缓解掉队者问题，并在数据与系统异构条件下提升训练效率。在异构边缘计算环境中，统计异构性和系统异构性都会显著影响收敛效率和模型性能。然而，现有的客户端选择方法往往独立处理这两类异构性因素，忽略了它们在通信轮次之间的耦合与动态影响。为解决这一局限，我们提出了FedCSGA，一种基于遗传算法的联邦学习客户端选择方法。FedCSGA将客户端子集编码为染色体，并通过一个联合整合统计与系统异构性的非线性适应度函数来评估这些子集。
tldr: 提出了一种基于遗传算法的联邦学习客户端选择方法FedCSGA，通过联合建模统计异构性与系统异构性的非线性适应度函数，实现每轮客户端子集的进化式优化选择。
en_tdlr: FedCSGA is a genetic algorithm-based client selection method for federated learning that jointly models statistical and system heterogeneity through a non-linear fitness function, enabling evolutionary optimization of per-round client subset selection.
